name: Boldenone undecylenate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A long-chain ester of boldenone approved in the United States only as a veterinary product for horses. There is no human FDA approval and no human labelling; it is a Schedule III controlled substance for human use. Veterinary approval only. No human FDA label exists.

systems.note: Androgen receptor agonism; the intended anabolic target.
Sought for lean mass; aromatises to estradiol.
Erythrocytosis is a class effect of androgens.
Adverse lipid shift is a class effect.
Androgen class hepatic concern; no human safety record exists.

monitors.why: Class erythrocytosis risk with no human dosing reference.
No human safety record exists for this compound.
